title: Synthesis, characterization and computational studies of copper(II) terpyridine-based metal–organic frameworks for the removal of emerging herbicide contaminant from aqueous solution
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49525-49544
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07218B, Paper
Open Access

Adedibu C. Tella, Sunday J. Olatunji, Solomon O. Oloyede, Allen T. Gordon, Adeniyi S. Ogunlaja, Peter A. Ajibade
Copper(II) metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) of 4,4′,4″-tri-tert-butyl-2,2′:6′,2″-terpyridine(N3ttb) were synthesized and characterized. The compounds were used as effeicient adsorbents for the removal of 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid.
